messages:
maria: FYI — opening this thread to track postmortem follow-ups for last night's cascading vendor outages (cloud region networking + model-registry auth failures + external auth provider throttling). Postmortem is here: https://redwood.company/pm/2026-03-vendor-outage

alex: Thanks. Can we list owners + timelines so nothing falls through?

samir: Quick summary from SRE side: 1) Cloud region AZ failure triggered increased latency, 2) model-registry healthchecks started returning 503s due to overloaded DB connections, 3) auth provider rate-limited token introspection calls. The combination caused ~30% error rate for dedicated customers over a 45min window.

jess: Agreed. I captured three recurring patterns: a) single-region dependency (cloud) without predictable failover, b) tight coupling between model-registry and external auth calls on request path, c) lack of graceful degradation (no read-only model cache).

maria: Action items I propose (short form):
- A1: Multi-region failover runbook + automation — owner: alex — due: 2026-03-30 — ticket: ENG-3421
- A2: Model registry connection pooling + circuit breaker + read-only cache when DB degraded — owner: samir — due: 2026-04-06 — ticket: ENG-3430
- A3: Auth token caching + backoff + partner escalation (auth provider) — owner: jess — due: 2026-03-29 — ticket: SEC-404
- A4: Customer communication template + SLA review for Dedicated customers — owner: kevin (CS) — due: 2026-03-28 — ticket: OPS-987

alex: I accept A1. Plan: add health probes to route manager, fail traffic at env level, and add automated cutover with canary. Will open PR for runbook + automation.

samir: I accept A2. Immediate next step: add connection pool metrics, implement short-circuit when DB latency > 200ms, and pre-warm read-only model cache with latest pinned models.

jess: I accept A3. Also filing a support case with auth-vendor (case #AV-6921) and requesting increased rate limits for token introspection from them.

kevin: I accept A4. CS will send a proactive note to affected Dedicated customers tomorrow. Ops will also propose SLA language changes.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation for this week — alex is primary, samir is secondary.

infra-bot: Logged new infra tickets: ENG-3421, ENG-3430. Linked runbook stub: https://git.redwood/sre/runbooks/vendor-failover.md

alex: Recording follow-ups for the runbook: include step-by-step failover commands, rollback steps, telemetry checks, and a post-cutover verification checklist. Will add a 30-min drill to run monthly.

samir: For model-registry: add a feature-flagged fallback path that serves from backup object store if DB is unavailable for >2m. Also add per-model circuit breakers so hot models don't take down the registry.

jess: For auth: implement local token cache (TTL 10s) + jittered exponential backoff. Also wrap token calls with a bulkhead so a flurry of requests from a single customer can't starve others.

maria: Timeline notes: we should treat A1/A3 as highest priority (regional failover + auth stabilization) to avoid repeat outages. A2 (model-registry hardening) is medium priority but must be done within 2 weeks.

kevin: Ops asks for a decision on proactive capacity (reserved instances / cross-region contracts) by EOW so we can budget.

alex: I'll include cost/benefit in ENG-3421 by 2026-03-27.

samir: One more recurring incident pattern: third-party throttling often correlates with our sudden retry behavior. We need to audit all retry policies across services. I created ENG-3455 for retry audit.

jess: Good call. Add that audit to the postmortem playbook as a required step for vendor-related incidents.

maria: Owner confirmations: alex (A1), samir (A2 + ENG-3455), jess (A3), kevin (A4). I'll update the postmortem with owners and deadlines and schedule a follow-up sync next Tue 10:00am PST.

alex: Sync time works for me.

samir: Works for me.

jess: On my calendar.

maria: Closing note: please add brief status updates in this thread as you make progress (PR links, ticket updates). I'll mark the postmortem status as "in progress" until all action items are closed and we run a multi-region drill. :memo: :shield:

infra-bot: Ticket ENG-3421 status: open. ENG-3430 status: open. ENG-3455 status: open.

oncall-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 2026-03-29 15:00 UTC.
